tabs.overview: Volumes come from the fluid intensity in Pad Setup; salt-tolerant friction reducers let produced water be reused; bacteria and iron are treated at the pits or on the fly.
tabs.engineering: Water analysis before the job; chemistry adjusted per the analysis.
tabs.safety: Lay-flat lines across roads; pit liners and fencing.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki fracturing fluids and additives (S50), propping agents (S51), API RP 19C (S52), API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), field practice (S9).

name: Frac water: fresh, brackish, produced, and recycled
function: The base water for the job from wells, ponds, pipelines, or recycled produced water, with its salinity, bacteria, iron, and solids set against the fluid design.
